lines.text: In this lesson, you will learn to test a game like a player, find bugs in rules and scores, and fix them.
Game makers ask testers to play and find problems.
Does the score match what you collected?
Maybe a treasure doesn’t disappear, or the win message never shows.
Fix one bug, then play again.
Bug! The score should be 2 after collecting 2 gems. Fix the code.
The second +1 was missing. Score fixed!
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
